news.title: Officers rammed in Gwinnett County incident, shoot at suspect vehicle

news.title: Man accused of performing sex act inside Lyft, pulling gun on man stopping him
news.summary: A Cobb County man is facing sex crime charges after he was accused of performing a sex act inside a rideshare.

news.title: Accused ‘West Georgia Monster’ indicted in Paulding County on rape, gun charges tied to 2012 sexual assault
news.summary: Bobby Lee Hart Jr., has now been indicted in Paulding, Cobb and Douglas counties. Authorities cite up to 25 possible victims.

news.title: Covington woman indicted after boyfriend’s remains found in shallow grave

news.title: VIDEO: Stolen car tied to armed robbery sparks chase along I-75

news.title: Six Flags Over Georgia death: Victim ejected from ride identified
news.summary: Hassan Jihad Ibn Kariem, 42, of Atlanta, died following an ejection from a roller coaster at Six Flags Over Georgia.

news.title: Man holding woman and child hostage shot by DeKalb police

news.summary: The DeKalb County Police Department said the suspect involved was taken to a hospital with critical injuries.

news.title: Drone and drugs seized during Monroe County traffic stop
news.summary: Deputies arrested a Jonesboro man after finding a drone, marijuana, and ecstasy inside his vehicle during a traffic stop in Monroe County.

news.title: Pedestrian killed in DeKalb crash; other wrecks snarl traffic
news.summary: A pedestrian was killed in a crash on westbound Lavista Road at Henderson Road in DeKalb County early Tuesday morning.

news.title: Car break-ins led Smyrna police to a wanted murder suspect
